useCases.title: HIMS eSPA - Electronic Sale and Purchase Agreement using Digital Signature
useCases.summary:
Business challenge: Malaysia’s property Sale and Purchase Agreement process traditionally requires physical identity checks, appointments and paper signing. This causes delays, inconvenience and fraud risks for remote buyers.
Implemented solution: KPKT’s eSPA digitises the process through HIMS and iDsaya. Users complete MyKad or passport eKYC using document validation, facial matching and liveness detection. After verification, they activate a digital certificate issued by a licensed Certification Authority, review the agreement in HIMS and authorise remote signing through iDsaya using a PIN and TOTP. JWT VC remains in pilot. Building on experience from a similar project, we plan to use it for credential verification during authentication. Pos Digicert is the issuer, iDsaya the holder and HIMS the verifier. The credential contains a pseudonymous ID, role, transaction reference, issuance and expiry dates.
Achieved outcomes: eSPA enables secure remote verification and legally recognised signing, reducing processing time, paperwork and physical visits while protecting document integrity. JWT VC strengthens participant and role verification without replacing PKI-based signing.

organizations.labelRaw: Ministry of Housing and Local Government

useCases.userJourney:
1.The housing developer registers the project and relevant parties in KPKT’s HIMS, including buyers, landowners, witnesses and authorised representatives.
2.HIMS sends each party an invitation to complete remote identity verification via the iDsaya mobile application.
3.Malaysians submit their MyKad, while non-Malaysians submit a passport. iDsaya performs document verification, facial matching and liveness detection to confirm the applicant’s identity.
4.Upon successful eKYC, a licensed Certification Authority (CA) issues and activates the user’s digital certificate. The user then creates PIN for signing authentication.
5.Developer prepares the prescribed eSPA in HIMS, and all required parties are notified when it is ready.
6.Each party reviews and authorises signing remotely using iDsaya, the certificate PIN and TOTP. The digital signature binds the verified signer to the document and enables detection of subsequent changes.
7.HIMS validates signatures, certificate status and completion by all required parties before recording the executed eSPA.
8.KPKT/JPN oversees the process, while relevant parties perform their respective roles. iDsaya provides eKYC and remote-signing functions
